svg.title: Dreams function review by game system
svg.desc: 27 of 9551 function names checked. 1540 functions have evidence-backed system assignments; 8011 functions do not. Sections show evidence-backed associations with parts of Dreams. Every cell is a real function. Every section area is proportional to its function count. Green means name checked; amber means reviewed but unresolved; gray means not reviewed. Assignments are incomplete; full system totals and completion are unknown.
